candidates.label: Adult-onset Still's disease (AOSD)
missing_or_uncertain: Typical evanescent rash not described; skin biopsy shows eosinophilic spongiosis rather than neutrophilic infiltrate

candidates.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) with serositis and arthritis
missing_or_uncertain: No ANA or anti-dsDNA results; rash not typical of SLE

candidates.label: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) / Macrophage activation syndrome (MAS)
missing_or_uncertain: No evidence of hemophagocytosis; no splenomegaly; no cytopenias

candidates.label: Drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS)
missing_or_uncertain: No drug exposure history; peripheral eosinophilia not documented

candidates.label: Acute rheumatic fever (ARF)
missing_or_uncertain: No evidence of preceding streptococcal infection; rash not typical of erythema marginatum

response.rationale: The combination of daily fevers, arthritis, pericarditis, hepatomegaly, extreme hyperferritinemia, and leukocytosis strongly supports Adult-onset Still's disease. The skin biopsy is atypical but not contradictory. SLE is less likely due to leukocytosis and extreme ferritin. HLH is considered but leukocytosis and lack of cytopenias/splenomegaly are against it. DRESS and ARF lack supporting history.
